howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取 golden_chat 的 Slack 聊天记录，包括 #engineering 和 #random 频道中的消息、代码片段、共享链接等，并据此回答相关问题。
howto.when: 当你在测试 golden_chat golden build 时触发；也可在需要查找该聊天历史中的解决方案、代码片段、团队讨论或共享资源时使用。

say.text: golden_chat 里 bob 发的 Python 代码是什么？
say.note: Claude 会从聊天记录中提取该代码片段。
Claude 会总结该频道消息内容。

say.text: golden_chat 里共享了哪些链接？
say.note: Claude 会列出聊天中出现的链接。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill lets Claude access the golden_chat Slack chat history, including messages, code snippets, shared links, and more from the #engineering and #random channels, and answer questions based on that content.
howto.when_en: Triggers when testing the golden_chat golden build, or when you need to look up solutions, code snippets, team decisions, troubleshooting steps, or shared resources from the golden_chat chat history.

say_en.text: What Python code did bob share in golden_chat?
say_en.note: Claude will extract the code snippets from the chat history.
Claude will summarize the messages in that channel.

say_en.text: Which links were shared in golden_chat?
say_en.note: Claude will list the links that appeared in the chat.
